three execute intervals rendered (18/16/17 frames in run summary); hit follows; no eligible no-hit recovery window.
execute state appears in retained state sequence, then hit or resolve; no recover frame. These are interrupted/terminal windows, not evidence of a recover render failure.

EnemyMotion.swift.behavior: finishFiniteActionR214 sends a pending hit to hit after execute; otherwise returnToRest(execute) attempts recover. Recover completion falls through returnToRest to idle.

BattlePlayback.swift.behavior: ordinary event playback is finite/sequenced; concurrent party hits can legitimately be pending at execute completion.

minimalGapOnlyCaptureIfPerIDClosureRequi.attempts: One fresh isolated challenge encounter per target; no forced pose, HP/gear edits, clock changes, or ordinary-save mutation. B_R01_A only counts if a real execute is rendered. E_R02_04 excluded from attack cohort.
acceptance: Same actor and scene generation show a completed execute with no pending hit at completion.
At least two rendered recover frames are joined to that execution; then an idle frame from the same actor appears before hit or resolve.
Marker/video and trace identify the same case; sample start/middle/end of recover at phone scale.
If a hit is pending or the encounter resolves first, record INTERRUPTED/NO_ELIGIBLE_WINDOW for that single attempt; this is not a renderer failure.
minimalGapOnlyCaptureIfPerIDClosureRequi.proposedBounds: 17 targets only, 1 attempt each, ≤20 min / ≤1.25 GB aggregate clips+traces; no recapture of the 11 already-covered IDs or the positive E_R02_01 route.
minimalGapOnlyCaptureIfPerIDClosureRequi.reuse: Reuse existing R424 capture guard/video/trace pipeline and fixture, but do not reuse the sealed 8-target runner unchanged. Gap-only case manifest must bind each case UUID and actor, retain previous/final saves, and preserve all earlier support/prefs.
